en: Hello, {player}! Warden Baoba here. Sorry to keep you waiting, but my Safari Zone is open at last!
Do you know the gate in the cave behind Cianwood City? Go through it and follow the cliff path, and you'll be there in no time.
We're a little out of the way, but do come and visit!
...You again. If you're here for the Gym, don't bother. The Leader's not even in it.
She's up that lighthouse, fussing over some sick Pokémon. A Gym Leader playing nurse!
A Pokémon too weak to stand isn't worth the time. You'd waste yours on it too, wouldn't you? That's why you'll never be strong.
